`abstract class LockableValue<T extends LockableValue<T>>`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/), [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.lock` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [LockableValue.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/lock/LockableValue.java)

Mutable value that can be locked, after which its setters refuse to change it and point to the methods that return a copy.

## Description

[`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) and [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) extend it: lock a value kept in a constant, so code that receives it cannot change it for everyone.

## Learn more

- [Colors and styling](/use/learn/style-and-motion/styling/)
- [Text](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text/)

### mutate

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: …, use …(...) to get a modified copy

Runs `mutation` on this value, then returns it; on a locked value, it throws an `IllegalStateException` whose message names the method `copy` that returns a modified copy.
